无进展保护覆盖重复失败、相同工具结果重复、持续只输出文字、上下文不足及模型流空闲；不限制持续取得新结果的长任务。
引用校验确认已交付证据的编号、版本与位置，不证明每句陈述都被来源语义蕴含。离散视频采样不等于逐帧观察。
en:
Durable events cover model / tool starts and ends, evidence, context archives, resource waits, answers and terminal states. Missing usage receipts remain unknown.
No-progress guards cover repeated failures, repeated identical tool results, text-only turns, exhausted context and idle model streams; productive long tasks may continue.
Citation checks establish delivered evidence identity, versions and positions, not semantic entailment. Discrete video samples do not prove frame-by-frame inspection.

zh:
模型层：常规 LLMManager 统一 chat / embed / rerank、任务路由、回退与健康冷却；Pi 使用独立主模型配置和 ModelTransport。
完整 Compose 启动 worker；开发模式是否运行 worker 与 Redis 是否启动是两个不同条件。
部署定位：当前主要面向单机可信工作区；Pi 范围与 token 校验不等于全站多租户 ACL。
本图依据 main 工作树代码静态核对，描述实现拓扑与数据契约，不表示本机此刻所有容器或外部服务均在线。
en:
Model layer: standard LLMManager centralizes chat / embed / rerank, task routing, fallbacks and health cooldowns. Pi has independent main-model settings and ModelTransport.
Full Compose starts a worker. In development, starting Redis does not imply a running worker.
Deployment targets a single trusted workspace. Pi scope and token checks are not application-wide multi-tenant ACLs.
This is a static implementation map verified against main; it does not claim that every local container or external provider is currently online.
